item.title: Vulnerabilities in nginx Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
item.description:
On November 18, 2026, nginx announced the availability of a fix for multiple critical vulnerabilities in nginx that could lead to remote code execution. These vulnerabilities affect nginx releases 1.9.5 through 1.31.8 and is fixed in releases 1.31.9 (mainline) and 1.30.7 (stable). 

These vulnerabilities were identified by the following CVEs:

  • CVE-2026-113425: NGINX ngx_mail_proxy_module vulnerability
  • CVE-2026-121810: NGINX ngx_http_v3_module vulnerability
  • CVE-2026-123007: NGINX ngx_http_v2_module vulnerability
  • CVE-2026-123633: NGINX ngx_http_v2_module vulnerability
  • CVE-2026-123634: NGINX resolver vulnerability

For more information, see the nginx Security Advisories.

This advisory will be updated as additional information becomes available.

This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-nginx-nov-2026-e8jska2s

<br/>Security Impact Rating: Critical <br/>CVE: CVE-2026-113425,CVE-2026-121810,CVE-2026-123007,CVE-2026-123633,CVE-2026-123634

item.title: Vulnerability in Oracle OpenJDK (Java4Shell) Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
item.description:
On November 17, 2026, Oracle announced the availability of fixes for a vulnerability in OpenJDK that could lead to remote code execution identified by CVE-2026-114938.

The vulnerability affects OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 and later on x86-64 platforms when processing Base64 encoded content. 

For more information, see the Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Advisory - November 2026 and the OpenJDK Vulnerability Advisory: 2026/11/17.

For additional information, see the Talos blog post: Talos Threat Advisory CVE-2026-114938: Critical vulnerability in OpenJDK JAVA

This advisory will be updated as additional information becomes available.

This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-nov2026-java-rce-eCa6ss9z

<br/>Security Impact Rating: High <br/>CVE: CVE-2026-114938
